name: PassRole path is encoded as a privilege transition through an unknown-privileges pivot (IAM-107)
note: iam:PassRole scoped to lambda plus lambda:CreateFunction is a compound escalation path. The graph must show the actual privilege transition, not a direct principal->service shortcut: principal --can-pass (iam:PassRole)--> a Passable role whose privileges are UNKNOWN to this analysis --can-execute-as (lambda:CreateFunction)--> the lambda service execution (the potential privilege-boundary crossing). The intermediate ROLE node is the crux - the analyzer KNOWS both grants are present but does NOT know the passed role's actual permissions, so it never overclaims a boundary crossing (threat-model T8). Edges keep evidence + certainty; the findings table remains the authoritative equivalent.
